prep.summary:
Billing worker hardening is complete and validated. `BillingWorker` no longer retains `_last_batch` references, preventing completed event payloads from being mixed into future batches. A regression test covers the issue, all 41 worker tests pass, and a 5,000-batch memory check showed stable behavior: approximately 7.3 MiB peak memory, 2.1 MiB retained memory, and no pending events. The full suite passes with 118 tests passed and 7 skipped. Decimal currency handling with `ROUND_HALF_UP` remains preserved, along with prior Ruff, formatting, and 91% line-coverage checks.

Terraform remains healthy with VPCs `10.10.0.0/16` and `20.0.0.0/16`; the new VPC peering connection is still pending acceptance. Cloud Run changes are allowed. Scheduler DST handling is complete, while customer-tag administration was intentionally discarded. Stripe webhook improvements and richer invoice metadata have not started. Payment retries still use exponential backoff.

CLI cleanup is complete. Duplicate invoice-date and currency parser options were consolidated into `_add_billing_filters()`, and the explicit `currency` destination was restored after tests caught its omission. Manual verification of `invoice list --currency usd --status open --limit 25 --json` succeeded against a temporary fixture database and returned the expected two open USD invoices. An obsolete command-layer assertion using `args.filters["currency"]` was updated to `args.currency`. All 22 command tests pass, and the broader CLI test set had previously passed 15/15.
